content: Ananaias, Safaira ngare Itou yaawa tuwodere onoware.
Ariya fai ete yafai, unyi Ananaias, nomo woya unyi Safaira. Ananaias no nomo oula matau ulate fai ete langa huuruwai.
Onodu moni ulate nogo tai, Ananaias no nogo nomo bona tafainga inyai. Woya fere no waha alai. Onodu Ananaias no yaawadu moni oruwanga temou dorofe minidu aposel nigai.

Ono wainga Pita benou letuwai, “Ananaias, ne taate boni Satan awa tunanga huwanyate langa bolo waha, onodu Hauri Guuni yaawa tuwau ganga ononaha, ne name oula matau ulate nomo moni tedu ulate huwarimu naha?

Ne oula waha ne nage name gauwou langa huuru wene. Onodu moni tene waha fere ne name dada, ne taate dada onowau ganga wa edonga. Ne taate boni isou inyaba beha tenaha? Ne fai yaawa nigonboni wahanga iwou adai isau. Uwa. Ne Itou nogo yaawa tuwau ganga ononaha.”
Ananaias no beele waha isidu, metaume bonanga fasadu onou umai. Ono wainga fai nere dada Ananaias langa heigai waha isidu, danga bagu umugane.
Ono wainga magana giila maidu nomo gogala ogola la dagedu bode, auledu togoi u-u kuru wane.
Aua eei usu wainga, Ananaias woya no gamu mayai. No dada nomo au langa heigai waha, no alai uwa.
Ono wainga Pita no benou letuwai, “Ne lehiyau, tere teire oula langa moni teyareha waha behanga yo?” Ono wainga aita letuwai, “Wa tigini. Behanga.”

Ono wainga Pita no benou letuwai, “Tere taate boyare Anyakaro nomo Hauri wala-wala tuwaru ganga beele ngado yareha? Isau. Nere fai name amede u-u kuruwane waha, mata arasai la golo wane gamu maide. Ne fere aule hinidu goyodbode.”
Ono wainga aita waha fasadu onou Pita afo hugu la taumedu umai. Ono wainga magana giila gamu maidu, aita waha umainga urane. Onodu nere auledu togoi nomo au hinemu la u-u kuru wane.
Ono wainga sios nomo fai-aita bagu oruwanga, fai-aita fereha bagu nere dada beha hei gainga beele isane waha, nere danga bagu onou umugane.
Dodokawou hugu fere-fere heigai.

Aposel nere fai-aita bagu gama la dodokawou hugu fere-fere tafane. Ono wanenga fai-aita bagu oruwanga Anyakaro bode huwanyanege ngalenga wainga, nere huwanyanege etengadu, tempel nomo orei huwanya la goidu, Solomon nomo waranda la komo gane.
Fai-aita bagu nere nebere komowou langa ada yafa gane waha, nere nage unyinege jaimu gane. Ariya fai-aita bagu waha nere umugedu, nere bagu ada goi komo gane.
Fai-aita bagu baingaro nere Anyakaro bode huwanyanege ngalenga wainga, no nomo komowou langa gamu mayane.

Ariya, Aposel nere dodokawou tafa gane wa, fai-aita bagu nere isi nigi gane. Waha bode fai-aita bagu nere taura fai malala la hanigedu tamai jala Pita golodu mai gai la tagaga yo kabali jala hinemu langa jimadu inyemu nigi gane, taate bona, Pita hoonga la golodu mai gonga, hoonga nomo anu waha taura fai waha la goyei nomo gau nigigai.

Nere fai-aita bagu taon Jerusalem jugunga la, nere fere maidu aposel nerigane. Nere taura fai bagu, nere fai hauri inyaba inyabamu nigane waha bagu hanigedu mayane. Nere fai-aita bagu waha oruwanga hilou heigane.
Ensel no aposel dagou mata awa tuwei nomo bona hoyo nigai.
Pris mora bagu nomo ilibumu gane, nere Sadyusi fai, nere aposel dada waha ono wanenga uredu bode huwanyanege danga bagu inyabawai.
Nere jaidu aposel yaasu nigidu dagou mata la tafa niganenga fai inyaba bagu gaara yafane.
Ono ganenga, ooru Anyakaro nomo ensel ete, dagou mata nomo jauli helufadu bona hanigedu malala mayai, onodu benou lenigai,
“Tere tempel nomo orei huwanya la goidu oto bonade, auma yafei nomo onowou eege beha oruwanga fai-aita bagu hai nagagu.”

Ono wainga, aposel nere beele waha isidu, eringe amina tempel la goidu, fai-aita bagu beele malalamudu lenigou haruwe taane. Ono ganenga, pris mora bagu nomo ilibumu gane bagu nere kaunsel bagu, Israel nebere mora bagu oruwanga, yaure niganenga maidu komo wane. Onodu nere aposel hanigedu mayei nomo bode dagou mata la beele huuru wane.
Ariya polis nere dagou mata la goyane wa, aposel nere walanga yafa ganenga nerigegu uwa. Onodu bode nere ege gidu goidu fai aroro benou lenigane,

“Ere dagou mata nomo jauli ureyaha, nere danga bagu sesemudu lok warane, jauli oofagou gat nere jauli oruwanga oofa bode otode. Ariya saini ere jauli helufa yaha waha, fai ete huwanya la yafa ganga urei uwa.”
Tempel oofagou fai nebere kepten no pris aroro bagu beele waha isidu, ninanege baingaro isane, onodu lewane, “Nere fai beha adadu yae wane?”
Ono wanenga, fai ete heigedu benou lenigai, “Isagu. Tere fai dagou mata la tafa nigiyaha waha, nere elebe tempel nomo orei huwanya la oto bode, fai-aita bagu beele lenigide.”
Ono wainga, kepten no polis bagu goidu aposel hanigedu mayane. Ariya, nere dada ete ono nigegu uwa. Nere umugane, gamaji fai-aita bagu megebu ayaru nagoguga bode.
Aposel nere kaunsel langa beele lewei nomo umugegu uwa.
Polis nere aposel hanigedu tamai kaunsel agenege la tafa nigane. Ono wanenga pris mora bagu no benou lenigai,

“Tere fai waha unyi langa fai-aita bagu beele adai malalamudu lenigei nomo danga bagu karu tigeye. Ono weye wa, tere beele gai malalamudu leya, Jerusalem haumu oruwa langa fai-aita bagu tebere beele amina isane. Onodu ere fai waha dukote weyenga umai iwou beele geege la tafagu ganga ono-onoya.”
Ariya, Pita no aposel ila bagu beele ege gidu benou lewane, “Ere Itou nomonga beele oojowei nomo. Ere fai nebere beele ada oojo woya.
Tere Yesus nauge ete la waridu dukote weyenga umai, ariya, ebere asage gane nebere Itou no ege jaimu tuwai.
Itou no hau tamanidu owo hilou la tafa tuwai yafana. No ere jala abiti higi bona gidu haigou fai, onodu no Israel ebere huwanyage ubuluwei nomo hoyo higi bona, une uulu hagonbona.
Dada beha Itou no ono gainga ureye, waha boya ere beele malalamudu leleya. Hauri Guuni fere dada beha bona beele malalamudu lelena. Itou no fai-aita bagu bolou oojo wane waha Hauri Guuni nigai.”
Gamaliel no kaunsel nere aposel foinga ono nigei nomo beele lenigai.
Kaunsel nere Pita nomo beele waha isidu, hounege danga bagu mayainga, aposel dunege kote wode ono wane.

Ono ganenga kaunsel ete otowai. No Farisi fai ete, nomo unyi Gamaliel. No nuuni beele isisiwou fai, fai-aita bagu no unyi jaimu gane. No fai nere aposel hanigedu goi malala langa saini tutu mene yafei nomo lenigai.
Nere malala heiganenga Gamaliel no kaunsel ila benou lenigai, “Tere Israel fai, tere fai beha dada ete ono nigagu ganga wonga, hilobainga, tere ninatege isi dedu bonade.

Tere isiya, saini ufaro goyei uwa, Teudas no jaidu bona lewai, ‘Ji fai anyakaro, ji unyife bagu,’ Ono wainga, nere fai 400 jugunga la onou no oojo tuwane. Ono wanenga, gabman no dukote wainga umai, fai no bode huwanyanege ngalengawai waha, nere fere‑feredu harawane, ono wanenga nebere haruwe ewe usuwai.

Iinga, saini gabman no fai-aita bagu unyinege elegai langa, Galiliha Judas no jaidu bona, fai-aita bagu ila nebere ninanege jaimu nagai. Ono wainga nere no oojo tudu bode, gabman usumuwei nomo oota jaimu wane. Ono wanenga no dukote wanenga, fai oruwanga no bode huwanyanege ngalengawai waha, heige harawane.

Onou waha boni ji elebe tere letigini, tere fai beha dada ete adai ono nigagu. Tere awa nigadenga yafode. Ariya, nere haruwe tede beha, fai nebere ninanege langa nga jaimuwei mata wogunga wa, no inyaba wonbona.
Ariya, Itou no nogo we haruwe waha jaimuwei mata wonga, tere karu nigei nomo edo uwa. Gamaji tere Itou bagu wara wagu ganga!” Ono wainga kaunsel nere Gamaliel nomo beele oojo wane.
Onodu, nere aposel yaure niganenga mayanenga, nere narigei nomo bode fai lenigane. Onodu nere Yesus unyi langa, beele ege adai malalamudu lewei nomo bode karu nigane. Onodu awa niganenga goyane.
Ono wanenga, aposel nere kaunsel awa nigidu malala heigane. Onodu bode nere Yesus unyi bode edo mayau tedege iwou ninanege isidu, Itou bode edega wane.

Ariya, nere fati oruwa manidu bode tempel langa, fai-aita bagu nebere mata langa, isisi nigou haruwe tegane. Nere hilou beele malalamudu lewei nomo haruwe awegu uwa. Nere beele tigini foomudu benou lenigi gane, Yesus no fai beha Itou no nomo fai-aita bagu ege gidu hanigei nomo bona beele baara tawai waha huuru tuwainga mai.
